# MCP Server Application to visualize your System's Info
To visualize we use the modelcontextprotocol inspector in local:
``` bash
mvn clean package
```
``` bash
npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector java -jar target/mcp-system-info-0.1.0.jar
```
